challenge_rules: reconstruct package power without using 83 kW as an algebraic input
report motor and auxiliary contributions separately
preserve electrical versus thermal cooling boundaries
require suction temperature before same-point PASS or REJECT_CANDIDATE
do not infer active count from installed count
do not promote owner fixed-speed basis as bidder evidence
do not substitute generic gas curves for helium-specific evidence
do not impute missing values as zero
emit sensitivity only for source-bound uncertainty ranges
PASS: independent same-boundary reconstruction is reproducible and within 82.17-83.83 kW
REJECT_CANDIDATE: complete eligible reconstruction is reproducible but outside 82.17-83.83 kW
DEFER: one or more essential reconstruction inputs are absent or ineligible
